title: LXR Hotels & Resorts to Debut in The Eternal City
summary: Hilton today announced an agreement with Benso srl to bring LXR Hotels & Resorts to Rome, marking the brand’s debut in the city.
body_markdown:
Listen to this article


0:00


Hortus Monti Rome, LXR Hotels & Resorts will transform six historic buildings to bring the brand’s signature blend of culture, design and discovery to Italy’s capital


- **Hortus Monti Rome, LXR Hotels & Resorts is expected to open in 2028, marking the brand’s debut in the Eternal City.**
- **The 147-room hotel will span six historic Umbertine-era buildings in the Monti district, offering guests a more intimate experience on Rome.**
- **Planned amenities include a tranquil central garden, restorative spa, signature restaurant and lobby bar, plus a rooftop terrace and sky bar with sweeping views across Rome.**


**ROME, Italy** –[Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/) today announced an agreement with Benso srl to bring LXR Hotels & Resorts to Rome, marking the brand’s debut in the city. Expected to open in 2028, Hortus Monti Rome, LXR Hotels & Resorts, will join LXR’s handpicked collection of independent, spirited properties, each distinguished by an individual story and a deep connection to its destination.


Set across six historic Umbertine-era buildings in the Monti district, the 147-room hotel will offer guests a more intimate perspective on Rome. The neighbourhood’s creative spirit and rich artisanal heritage will shape the guest experience, inviting travellers to explore beyond the city’s celebrated landmarks, discovering Monti through its architecture, culture and flavours.


-


Hortus Monti Rome, LXR Hotels & Resorts - Arrival Garden


-


Hortus Monti Rome, LXR Hotels & Resorts - Pool


Blending historic character with contemporary elegance, the hotel will offer an intimate, considered expression of Roman luxury, with thoughtful, unobtrusive service that anticipates guests’ needs, respects their privacy and makes each stay feel effortless. With a tranquil central garden at its core, the hotel will also include a restorative spa, signature restaurant and lobby bar offering inviting spaces to relax and unwind. Above, a rooftop terrace and sky bar will offer sweeping views across the city. Monti’s makers, flavours, stories and streets will inspire authentic, unhurried experiences throughout these spaces.


The guest journey will be shaped around intuitive, personal hospitality, with thoughtful details at every stage of the stay. From a warm welcome and carefully considered in-room touches to local recommendations and insider insights, guests will be encouraged to explore Monti at their own pace. An illustrated neighbourhood guide and opportunities to connect with local makers will help reveal the district’s lesser-known streets, independent ateliers and hidden corners, making discovery feel effortless and personal.


-


Hortus Monti Rome, LXR Hotels & Resorts - All Day Dining


-


Hortus Monti Rome, LXR Hotels & Resorts - Bar


Food and beverage will offer another example of the hotel's connection to its surroundings, with a culinary approach inspired by Roman traditions, seasonal ingredients and the creativity of local producers. From relaxed, unhurried mornings to menus celebrating neighbourhood flavours - including handmade pasta, seasonal herbs and regional wines - dining will invite guests to experience the tastes and rituals of Rome throughout the day. The hotel’s restaurant, lobby bar and rooftop spaces will provide distinct settings for everything from leisurely meals to aperitivo and sunset gatherings.


Dan Wakeling, vice president, development, luxury & residences, EMEA, Hilton, said, “The signing of the first LXR Hotels & Resorts property in Rome marks an exciting milestone in Hilton’s continued growth in Italy and reflects the wider momentum behind our luxury expansion across Europe. Rome is a city of extraordinary history with celebrated landmarks and monuments, but much of its allure is found in the details of everyday life that give the city its unique character. From engaging with local artisans to sharing an aperitivo inspired by the neighbourhood, the guest experience will bring LXR’s spirit of personal adventure to life through experiences that feel intimate, authentic and distinctly Roman. We look forward to welcoming guests to discover the Eternal City through a new lens.”


Hortus Monti Rome, LXR Hotels & Resorts - Junior Suite Bedroom


Matteo Cidonio, for Benso srl, said, “We are proud to collaborate with Hilton to introduce the LXR Hotels & Resorts brand to Rome. This project will create a unique destination that celebrates the city’s heritage and the distinctive creative spirit of Monti, while delivering exceptional service and meaningful experiences for modern luxury travellers. We look forward to bringing this vision to life and creating a place where guests can connect with the character of the neighbourhood in a truly personal way.”


The guest experience at Hortus Monti Rome, LXR Hotels & Resorts will also be brought to life through three signature concepts that bring the creative textures of Monti into the hotel. These experiences will reflect the hotel's belief that the best way to discover a place is to take part in its everyday life, creating opportunities for meaningful encounters with the people, creativity and traditions that make Monti distinctive.


This signing of this management agreement marks another milestone in a vibrant period of growth for[LXR Hotels & Resorts](https://stories.hilton.com/brands/lxr-hotels) , as the portfolio now has more than 40 properties operating or under development across the globe, including the recently opened[Sandblu Santorini](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/jtrblol-sandblu-santorini/) ,[Cameo Beverly Hills](https://www.cameobeverlyhills.com/) and[The Den Bengaluru](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/blrolol-the-den-bengaluru/) .

Hortus Monti Rome, LXR Hotels & Resorts will have 147 rooms.

Hortus Monti Rome, LXR Hotels & Resorts will offer a tranquil central garden, a restorative spa, a signature restaurant and a lobby bar, as well as a rooftop terrace and sky bar with sweeping views across Rome.

Found in the world's most alluring destinations, each hand-selected property boasts its own storied past and is infused with the essence of its distinctive locale, providing a luxurious hub for the discerning adventurer. As part of its commitment to enriching the guest experience, LXR Hotels & Resorts celebrates experiential travel with the Pursuit of Adventure, a brand signature that immerses guests in authentic, curated experiences that reflect the unique culture and character of each destination.
